_comment: Premium-only abilities. One-of-one: exactly 5 exist, each held by a SINGLE player at a time via the shared exclusive claim registry (db.data.seasonRuntime.exclusiveSpinWinners, keyed by the ids below prefixed 'ability:'). GIFTED — not spun — to buyers of the MONTHLY premium plan: one picked at random from whatever is unclaimed, guaranteed outright, no luck roll (plugins/premium.js handleConfirm, gated on planKey==='monthly'). Premium is never a gamble for an ability: weekly and yearly buyers (and the rare monthly buyer who arrives while all 5 are held) leave with Crown's Favor (data/abilities.json) instead, so nobody who pays walks away with an empty slot. A player holds at most one (player.premiumAbility); a renewal keeps the one they hold. EVERYTHING granted leaves with the plan: on expiry (main.js sweep) or .premium-revoke, stripPremiumAbilities() in lib/premium-abilities.js clears the ability and RELEASES the registry claim, so it goes back on the shelf for the next buyer. Engine lives in lib/premium-abilities.js; passives fire from the combat hit-sites, actives are their own command plugins registered in handler.js BATTLE_ALLOWED_COMMANDS. Durations that scale by opponent strength use minTurns for a stronger foe and maxTurns for a weaker one. Effects reuse the wired freeze/burn types; sleep is added in lib/effects.js.

abilities.name: Freeze Touch
abilities.flavor: Your skin runs cold enough to still a beating heart. Whoever raises a hand against you feels it seize in their fingers first.
abilities.passiveDesc: Anyone who lands a hit on you risks freezing solid for a turn, losing their momentum and their swing.
abilities.activeDesc: Once per battle, seize the enemy solid. They skip their turns while the frost holds (3 to 5 turns by how strong they are).

abilities.name: Heat Blaze
abilities.flavor: You burn from the inside out. Every blow thrown at you comes back scorched, and the fire remembers the hand that struck.
abilities.passiveDesc: Anyone who lands a hit on you is set alight, taking burn damage each turn for a while after.
abilities.activeDesc: Once per battle, wash the enemy in fire. Heavy burn that eats at them for 3 to 5 turns by how strong they are.

abilities.name: Night Eyes
abilities.flavor: Meet your gaze and the world goes heavy and dim. Few can keep their eyes open for long once you look back.
abilities.passiveDesc: A hit against you sometimes drags the attacker under, dropping them to sleep for a moment.
abilities.activeDesc: Once per battle, put the enemy under. They fall asleep and skip their next 3 turns.

abilities.name: Daylight Ring
abilities.flavor: A plain ring that still remembers the sun. Turn it once and the morning breaks on your terms, not the world's.
abilities.passiveDesc: No passive. Its power is the sunrise you call on demand.
abilities.activeDesc: Once per battle, the sun rises for you. For 5 turns you surge past the enemy in every stat; if they were already the weaker one, their attacks do nothing at all.

abilities.name: Jack of All Trades
abilities.flavor: A little frost, a little fire, a little sleep. You never mastered any one of them, so you simply kept them all.
abilities.passiveDesc: Small passive chance on every hit against you to freeze, burn, or drowse your foe. Weak versions of everything, no active move.
